svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Edge-Cloud Quantized Speech Container & Sovereign Residency Architecture (Stage 372 · P737–P738)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of pure public cloud WAN blackout & cross-border audio egress risk vs P737 Edge INT8/FP8 Quantized Speech Container fallback (<=400ms WAN RTT gate, <=1.5% WER drift) and P738 Sovereign Zero-Raw-Audio Cloud Egress Fence.
svg.text: STAGE 372 · TOPIC 12 · P737–P738
Edge-Cloud Quantized Speech Containers & Sovereign Audio Residency
端云混合量化语音容器与数据主权架构选型：断网/弱网 <=400ms 本地 INT8/FP8 逃生 (P737) 与原始声纹零出境围栏 (P738)
① P737: Edge Quantized Speech Container & WAN Blackout Fallback
⛔ Legacy Cloud-Only Voice Agent (Tunnel / Mine / Hospital WAN Outage)
• Vehicle enters tunnel / Factory WAN RTT spikes >900ms -> Cloud WebSocket times out
• Safety-critical voice commands ("Emergency stop", "Open cabin door") completely dead!
• Or Naive INT4 Quantization collapses vocoder prosody & spikes WER by >6.5%!
Constraint: Edge NPU/GPU has only 4–8GB VRAM; cannot run unquantized 70B FP16 models locally
✅ P737: Mixed-Precision Edge Container (FP8/INT8) + <=400ms WAN Gate
1. Asymmetric Mixed-Precision Quantization: Keep Acoustic Frontend & Vocoder in
FP16/BF16, quantize Conformer/SLM weights to INT8/FP8 (VRAM -52%, WER drift <=1.5%)
2. Sub-400ms WAN Health Circuit Breaker: When cloud RTT > 400ms or loss > 5%,
switch to local Disconnected Speech Container / NPU without dropping the call
3. Tiered Offline Intent Execution: Local deterministic safety/control commands
execute in 0 WAN hops; complex cloud queries queue with local voice acknowledgment
P737 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P738: Sovereign Audio Residency & Zero-Voiceprint Cloud Egress
Deployment Topology Selection Matrix
• Topology A: Pure Public Cloud API — Zero edge hardware ops; best for general e-commerce/retail
• Topology B: Edge-Cloud Split (Local STT/TTS + PII Scrub + Cloud LLM) (P737+P738)
Raw biometric voice stays on-prem/in-cabin; only tokenized text reaches cloud frontier LLM
• Topology C: Fully Air-Gapped Sovereign Container (Azure Disconnected Container)
For classified defense, nuclear/grid SCADA, and zero-internet maritime/subsea rigs
✅ P738: Biometric Voiceprint & Sovereign Jurisdiction Hard Fence
• Why Raw Voice Is Biometric PII: Waveform carries speaker identity, health, and age
regulated under GDPR Art. 9, PIPL, Illinois BIPA, and HIPAA Safe Harbor
• Edge Audio-to-Token Demarcation (<=35ms budget): Terminate RTP audio inside
sovereign edge container, strip d-vector & PII spans, egress only de-identified text
• Cross-Border Route Block: 0ms block on raw PCM routing to non-sovereign regions
P738 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 372 · DIMENSION 375)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P737/P738): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Edge NPU/Container Inference & WAN Probing: Hardware quantization throughput and live WAN RTT are not_measured in local unit tests.
